episodes.synopsis: Jackpot! Rilakkuma wins free tickets to Nakasugi Land, the local amusement park that will soon be closing its doors forever.
episodes.title: An uneasy feeling

episodes.synopsis: Rilakkuma has lots of fun playing video games with a new friend, but the big fuzzy bear gets a little dizzy after playing too much. Next stop: teacups!
episodes.title: Game battle with Emiri

episodes.synopsis: Kiiroitori ends up getting stuck in a tree. Can Rilakkuma and friends rescue the little bird? Kaoru and Korilakkuma finally make it into the park.
episodes.title: Eiji and the jungle tour

episodes.synopsis: It's way past lunchtime and everyone's getting hungry. Kaoru and Korilakkuma need to get their bentos back from the clown who ran off with them quick!
episodes.title: Clown in love

episodes.synopsis: Rilakkuma, Tokio and Kiiroitori are all really hungry; luckily, the park employee that's been helping them notices and kindly buys them lunch.
episodes.title: Suzune’s an idol

episodes.synopsis: The park secret is out!? As the sun starts to set, Suzune remembers how much she used to love this job. At long last, it's time for her final concert.
episodes.title: The secret of the theme park

episodes.synopsis: The power's out throughout the park and it's getting dark, but Kaoru starts beaming when she finally meets up with Hayate — and the rest of the crew.
episodes.title: Strategy meeting in the dark

episodes.synopsis: There's only one way to get the power back on in time for the parade; Korilakkuma has to send her remote controlled ducky into the underground maze.
episodes.title: The last parade
